beats: Our TV quiz wall kept inventing scenes for subjects with nothing but a topic name to show.
Other cards — maths, word cards, plan topics — got a scene less than half the time, at random.
So a kid could hit several plain cards before a scripted one ever appeared.
Now the writer skips subjects with nothing to show, and Cloudflare Workers doubles scene coverage.
The kiosk now hunts for a card with a scene, never repeating one within forty-five minutes.
